newsitem.title: USA: Techs, networking stock weakness pressures Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Techs, networking stock weakness pressures Nasdaq.

text.p: Nasdaq shares dropped on Monday as weakness in technology stocks weighed heavily, ending last week's late gains.

"Things were just down and dirty all day. There's no hard selling pressure on the techs. But the techs just seem to drift and drift," said Jack Bayer, managing director and head over-the-counter trader at Oppenheimer & Co.
The Nasdaq composite index dropped 18.35 points or 1.50 percent to close unofficially at 1204.22.
Declining issues beat advancing issues 2657 to 1576 on total volume of 555 million shares. Nasdaq shares have fallen in the past five of the previous 10 sessions.
Computer networking stocks slid after Intel Corp unveiled inexpensive gear aimed at speeding links between personal computers arranged at workgroups.

APAC TeleServices Inc shed 10-3/8 to 11-1/8 after reporting first quarter earnings that were below analysts' estimates and warning that results for 1997 will be hurt by costs for a large outsourcing client.
More fortunate was Goulds Pumps Inc, which gained 13-5/16 to 36-3/16 after it agreed to be acquired by ITT Industries Inc.
